concerns.text: The power analysis (Phase 4) merely states “effect size d = 0.8, power ≥ 0.8” without justification of why d = 0.8 is appropriate for the disentanglement or editing hypotheses, nor does it link the calculated N to the actual distribution of text‑only vs. image‑only crops in the Omni‑Doc‑1 dataset. This leaves the sample‑size determination under‑specified and risks under‑powering the study.

Phase 6 aggregates “metric placeholders” but the plan never details the concrete statistical procedures required by the functional requirements (e.g., DCI computation, 1 000‑permutation test, Bonferroni correction, linearity R² test). Without explicit steps, construct validity of the measured constructs (disentanglement, linearity, layout preservation) cannot be assured.

Confounding factors such as crop size, text density, image complexity, or OCR confidence are not addressed. The plan’s purity filter (>10 % overlap) is mentioned only in the spec, not operationalized here, and no strategy is described for controlling or reporting these potential confounds.

The early‑termination logic (abort if dataset or model unavailable) satisfies FR‑001/FR‑002 in the infeasible case, but the plan does not provide an alternative methodological path (e.g., a synthetic benchmark) that would still allow any empirical validation of the hypotheses when resources are missing, leaving the research question unanswered in the most likely real‑world scenario.
